_about: The delivery app (a fictional brand: rename it here). Orders ping on a tablet during service: accept within accept_secs (real seconds at 1x) or the app counts it as missed. You promise it ready prep_secs of service time after you accept it (service time runs fast: one second is about two minutes on the clock); a rider turns up then and waits up to rider_secs. The app keeps commission of everything the customer pays and the delivery fee. Its rating of you (1-5) sets how often you come up in the app: orders a day = (base + per_size x premises size) x (rating / 4.5)^2.
name: Hungrr
